canonical_basis: Riot describes Elder Dragon as a powerful late-game behemoth and short-term objective. The native single-boss physical encounter is an adaptation; no execute or Dragon Soul is inferred.
method: Original painted 2D pose masters generated from text and the own motion master for identity. No 3D, original troop pixels or third-party artwork used as generation input. Technical alpha-component isolation preserves original painted RGB and core alpha.
project_adaptation: Living flying2hex physical-melee epic boss with charcoal-slate scales, pale ivory crown and tusks, white-silver neck mane and massive darkteal wings. Unique nonrecruitable identity; finite authored ElderPit guarded by elemental drakes. No execute, breath, immunity, DragonSoul, spells or globalbuff imported.
